notes: Printers no longer print a page of garbage when they are scanned: Wrenscan never sends anything to a printer's raw printing port.
Device names: every device is listed with its name as soon as it is found, more devices get a name, and the clearest name wins (for example 'Shaunas-MacBook-Pro' instead of 'MAC').
Microsoft 365 check: the sign-in link and code now appear in a box at the top of the screen, with Copy code and 'Skip Microsoft 365 this time', and the sign-in starts at the beginning of the scan.
The activity log no longer jumps back to the top while you scroll it.

Spam checks: Wrenscan tells you if your internet address is on a spam blocklist (usually a sign that a device is infected), if a program on a PC is sending email directly, and if a PC uses DNS that doesn't block known-bad sites.
Home Plus and Business: one click blocks outgoing spam on a PC and switches it to Quad9 filtering DNS.
Updates: copies that aren't picked for a new version yet are still brought up to the latest version everyone has.
